description: Local synthetic English VR instructions, using installed character recordings as voice references. Not original actor recordings.

specific.jump: A button on your right controller
specific.show_health: lower grip button on your left controller

lines.text: Use Wingardium Leviosa on this statue. Move it onto the large plate with the {move}. Hurry!
Move the floating statue onto the plate with the {move}.
Watch the Wingardium Leviosa symbol carefully as I demonstrate it. When I finish, hold the {cast} and trace the symbol with your controller. Release the button when you are finished.
Run towards the ledge and press the {jump} to jump across.
Run towards the ledge and press the {jump} to jump across. If you fall, you can climb back up and try again.
To jump, press the {jump}. It is highlighted on your controller.
This is the symbol for the Alohomora spell. When I finish, hold the {cast} and trace the symbol with your controller. Release the button when you are finished.
Steer your broom with the {move}. Move it left or right to turn, forwards to climb, and backwards to descend.
Hold the {cast} to accelerate. Hold the {jump} to fly slowly and precisely.
Release the {move} to return to level flight. You can look around freely.
Hold the {cast} and aim your wand at the target with your controller. Release the button to cast the spell.
Hold the {cast} and aim your wand at the target with your controller. Release the button to cast the spell. You can practise on this gargoyle.
Watch my wand. Then hold the {cast} and trace the symbol with your controller. Release the button when you are finished.
This is the symbol for the Flipendo spell. Hold the {cast} and trace the symbol with your controller. Then release the button.
Watch the correct Incendio symbol carefully. Hold the {cast} and trace the symbol with your controller. Release the button when you are finished.
We need twenty-five beans, Harry. Come back when you have found them all. Hold the {show_health} to see your inventory at your left hand. It also shows how many beans you have collected.
